confirmed.name: wallet.kaspenet.io
confirmed.what: A lookalike of the Kaspa web wallet at wallet.kaspanet.io: "kaspenet" instead of "kaspanet". PhishDestroy reports it as a crypto drainer posing as Kaspa Wallet, built to get people to connect their wallets and approve transactions that empty them. It was registered on 25 Nov 2025 and no longer resolves (we checked on 22 Oct 2026). If you approved anything on it, move your funds to a new wallet.

confirmed.name: kaspawallet.net
confirmed.what: A site titled "Kaspa Wallet" that is not run by Kaspa's developers. PhishDestroy lists it as a crypto scam (first detected on 25 Aug 2025), and 15 of 89 VirusTotal engines flag it. PhishDestroy's automated brand label names a different coin, but the page title it recorded is "Kaspa Wallet". The domain still resolved when we checked on 22 Oct 2026.

unverified.name: kasplex.io
unverified.what: Kasplex, the Kaspa token protocol and layer 2, uses kasplex.org: its GitHub organisation links there. Some search summaries also mention kasplex.io. That domain was registered on 6 Feb 2024 and has no website: it didn't resolve when we checked on 22 Oct 2026. Use kasplex.org.
unverified.unknown: Who registered kasplex.io and whether it has anything to do with Kasplex. A statement from Kasplex either way would settle it.

label.name: BlockDAG (BDAG)
label.what: A separate project with its own coin, BDAG, sold through a long-running presale on its own website. It is not part of Kaspa and isn't built on Kaspa. "BlockDAG" is also the general name for the kind of ledger Kaspa uses, and promotional articles pitch BDAG as the next Kaspa. Kaspa itself had no presale.
